children: Lookonchain said Machi Big Brother (@machibigbrother) is currently the largest on-chain ETH long holder with more than $100 million in ETH long positions. According to Odaily, he closed part of his position seven hours ago after the market fell, realizing a loss of $1.96 million. His current holdings include 41,000 ETH, 75,000 HYPE, and 45 BTC.

title: Machi Big Brother Holds Over $100 Million in ETH Longs After Partial Liquidation
